name: application-faceted-search-sidebar
title: Faceted Search Sidebar
description: Collapsible filter groups combining checkbox facets with per-option result counts and a two-thumb price range facet.
useWhen: Building a product listing, catalog, or search results page where users narrow results by multiple independent dimensions.
Each filter option benefits from showing a live result count so users know a facet's usefulness before selecting it.
You need distinct facet types (checkbox groups, ranges) coexisting in one collapsible sidebar.
avoidWhen: The filters are a small, flat set already applied and just need to be displayed/removed as chips — use `data-filter-bar` for that applied-filter layer instead.
There's only one filter dimension — a single `selects` or `toggle-group` is simpler than a full facet sidebar.
The page is too narrow for a persistent sidebar — consider a `drawer` or `sheet` housing the same facet groups instead of forcing this layout.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width column meant for a sidebar rail; on narrow viewports, house it inside a `drawer` or `sheet` instead of shrinking it in place.
accessibility: The sidebar is a <nav> with an aria-label describing it as filters, distinguishing it from primary site navigation.
Each facet group's trigger has aria-expanded reflecting its open state and aria-controls referencing the panel it toggles.
Checkbox facets are real <input type="checkbox"> elements inside <label>s, so they are keyboard operable and their state is announced natively.
The price range's two thumbs are positioned with inline styles computed from real numeric state, not hardcoded percentages, so custom range values stay accurate.

variants.title: Faceted Search Sidebar
variants.description: Category checkboxes with counts, a price range facet, a collapsed Brand group, and a clear-all action.
accessibility: Facet group expand/collapse state is real aria-expanded state, not just a rotated chevron.

variants.title: Faceted Search Sidebar (Dark)
variants.description: Faceted search sidebar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Checkbox and range-thumb colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
